messages.subject: Re: CFI = 0 in path analysis with binary predictor and binary mediator on continuous outcome
parts:
On 12/7/22 15:56, sophie wrote:
> baseline model is not significant at all and only has 1 DF.

That is because lavaan allows for 'free' slopes in the baseline model
(if conditional.x = TRUE), while you have to specify them yourself in
the user model.

To force 'fixed-to-zero' slopes in the baseline model (resulting in a
much worse fit), you can set the option

baseline.conditional.x.free.slopes = FALSE

or refit the model with conditional.x = FALSE.

Yves.
